# Data Source: tfe_organization_audit_configuration

Gets information about the audit configuration for a given organization.

~> **Note:** This data source requires using the provider with HCP Terraform.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe.data_tfe_organization_audit_configuration.DataTfeOrganizationAuditConfiguration(self, "example",
            organization="my-org-name"
        )
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization.

### Optional

- `audit_trails_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Audit Trails is enabled for the organization.
- `hcp_log_streaming_enabled` (Boolean) Whether HCP Audit Log Streaming is enabled for the organization.
- `hcp_organization` (String) The destination HCP Organization for HCP Audit Log Streaming.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization audit configuration.
